description:
[Trading Data API] Recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetual swaps for a coin: each event with time, liquidated side, bankruptcy price, size and USD notional, plus long vs short liquidated totals and the largest event — Recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetual swaps for a coin: each event with time, liquidated side, bankruptcy price, size and USD notional, plus long vs short liquidated totals and the largest event. Real exchange data, no estimates.

**Example:** `/v1/liquidations?coin=ETH&limit=50`

coin.description: Optional. Ticker such as BTC (default), ETH, SOL.

name: liquidations
